title: Sign an NDA for the offering memorandum
summary: Review and sign the seller's confidentiality agreement so the full marketing package can be released.
outlineSteps: Confirm who is asking and for which property
Read the confidentiality agreement in full
Check which entity signs and who signs for it
Check what counts as confidential and the permitted uses
Check the no-contact terms for tenants, staff and lenders
Check the non-solicitation terms and how long the agreement lasts
Check who may receive the materials, including lenders and partners
Mark up the terms the sponsor cannot meet
File the signed copy and track its obligations
